newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Ege Biracilik to double capital.
newsitem.headline: Turk Ege Biracilik to double capital.

text.p: Turkish brewer Ege Biracilik ve Malt Sanayii A.S. said it planned to double its capital from current 2,128.29 billion lira by issuing one bonus share for each existing share.

In a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange, Ege Biracilik said it planned to meet 1,809.05 billion lira of the bonus issue by funds from the re-evaluation of fixed assets and 319.24 billion lira of it from 1996 dividends.
The company plans a 350 lira dividend per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share. It said it would distribute 150 lira of the dividends in the form of bonus share and pay out 200 lira in cash from May 26.
The capital increase is subject to approval by the regulatory Capital Markets Board. Ege Biracilik is largely owned by Turkish brewery, automotive and stationery group Anadolu Endustri Holding.
